The '''Pyrewood Armorer''' is a [[human]] [[armor]] [[vendor]] found at the [[Blacksmith (building)|Blacksmith]] in [[Pyrewood Village]] in [[Silverpine Forest]]. At night, he transforms into his [[worgen]] form as the '''[[Moonrage Armorer]]'''.

==Notes==
*He is affiliated with [[Stormwind (faction)|Stormwind]] during the daytime to make him unattackable by Alliance players.
